messages:
Jin: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

Jin: Done: landed KV prefetch patch in canary (PR #842). Observed ~8% p95 improvement on small seqs.
Jin: Blocker: seeing occasional slot steal in shard-3 during microbursts, need more logs to confirm whether it's scheduling or eviction thrash. :thinking_face:
Jin: Today: add more structured logs and wire bench fixture to reproduce slot steal locally. Will ping infra for tracing flags.

Sam: Nice, saw the PR diff — looks clean. Do you have the bench run?

Jin: paste below the latest run from bench-bot:
```
bench-bot: kernel-bench v2.3
model: 7B
seq: 64
baseline p95: 42ms
canary p95: 38.6ms
throughput +5% under steady load
```

Sam: Solid. Can you capture a flamegraph next? Want to see if prefetch is moving time from kernel stalls to memcpy.

Maria: What is the config for the canary nodes? Are they running slightly different quant libs? We saw a reg last week tied to a new cuBLAS knob.

Jin: Canary is same image, but using kernel-optimizer v1.9 and a different kernel selection table (auto-tuned). Not cuBLAS changes. I'll include full env in the log.

Ollie: Heads-up — I pushed a small batching heuristic tweak (PR #847) that prefers fill-to-target on 1-3 token requests. Could interact with prefetch by changing slot occupancy.

Sam: Thanks for the heads-up. Can you add a quick smoke bench? If it conflicts we should stall rollout.

Ollie: Will run smoke now.

bench-bot: smoke completed — tiny impact on overall throughput: -0.5% but reduced tail in 1-token latencies. Details in CI link: https://ci.internal/bench/847

Maria: If that reduces single-token tail we probably want it. The slot steal might be more visible with many 1-token bursts.

Jin: Good point. I'll run combined scenario: microburst pattern with 70% 1-token, 30% 64-token.

Sam: Also need a CR review: @Maria can you glance at PR #842 and #847? Nothing heavy, mostly comments and one line in kernel allocator. Quick approve if fine. :pray:

Maria: I'll look after lunch. If I see allocator churn I'll request changes.

Jin: Blocker update — slot logs show eviction spikes around 03:14:22 UTC, attaching snippet in thread (copied below).

Jin: `SLOT_EVICT shard=3 slot=271 age=42ms reason=prio_overflow`
Jin: multiple adjacent evicts within 200ms.

Ollie: That pattern screams prefetch + burst filling a single slot pool. Maybe we need soft-fencing between prefetch and batch fill.

Sam: Proposal: add a tiny jitter to prefetch start times per-request-id to spread hammering. Low-risk experiment.

Maria: Agree. If it's low-risk we can canary it with 1% roll. Add feature flag.

Jin: I'll implement jitter and the extra logs. Aim to roll canary tomorrow morning.

Ollie: I'll coordinate to pause the batching rollout for the 2-hour window during the canary.

bench-bot: scheduled microburst combo bench for tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Will post results automatically here.

Sam: Thanks all. Quick checklist: Jin -> logs + jitter PR, Ollie -> pause rollout, Maria -> CRs, bench-bot -> bench runs. Ping here with links. :thumbsup:
